protocol.scope: Same3 FFHQ x4tasks sigma_model=.05, fixed original30 grid. Identical completed nine-unroll learned entry; online controller at ALL30 positions in final unroll. No model/seed/noise/grid/LM-target tuning. No additional final sampling.
protocol.arms: BASE gamma1; LEGACY_SCALAR originalA71 current-state formula; REAL_SCALAR actual-response length; REAL_DIAG joint signed coefficient solve; DIAG_DIR_SCALAR_LEN and SCALAR_DIR_DIAG_LEN crossed vectors. Each arm recomputes BOTH candidate vectors on ITS OWN evolving state wherever needed. Never transplant A95/A96 step vectors or another arm trajectory.
protocol.objective: Unchanged A95 real-response target base+omega*(Py-base), omega=(1-M*sigma^2/||r||^2)+, physical coefficient p, full cross-response LM, MAX_OUTER20/MAX_TRIALS4/CG12/inexactRTOL.1/gradRTOL1e-3+ATOL1e-6. Diagonal initialized with same-state scalar only, no norm cap or gamma penalty. Nonconverged last accepted iterate explicitly retained as finite-budget algorithm.
protocol.endpoint: s>=0: actual clamped raw next denoiser. At final0->-1: m_-1(x)=x, actual returned clean-coordinate state, NOT alpha[-1]/network t=-1 or extra terminal denoising. Terminal H JVP/VJP counted as operator derivatives separately from NN derivatives.
protocol.degeneracy: q=0 implies only zero diagonal/native-ray correction, recorded ZERO_NATIVE_FEASIBLE_SET. Crossed zero-length vectors follow A96 semantics; undefined nonzero requested diagonal direction stops, no replacement policy.
protocol.pairing: Every arm starts original entry RNG and consumes original29 innovations only. Solver never draws sampling RNG. Per-step native call=t, all lookahead calls=s>=0; no negative-time NN. BASE/LEGACY outputs must match completed A71 paired tensors relativeL2<=1e-6; every tail RNG matches A92. No GT before all30 actions complete.
protocol.costs: Only last30 reconstructed here; 270 native forwards/nine optimization rounds inherited, not free method cost. Equivalent full reconstruction forward count=270+this arm actual NN calls. All response bases, JVP/VJP forwards, rejected trials and solver costs recorded; terminal operator derivatives separate. Timing is suffix + controller/checkpoint/bookkeeping, not independent full300 wall-clock.
protocol.checkpoint: Each successful position gets immutable step PT+SHA metadata. Resource pause ONLY between positions, with all finished steps verified on resume and same pinned GPU. Failed/interrupted in-progress position is retained, no automatic retry. All arrays/full solver traces stay server, lightweight step summaries and final PNG/JSON uploaded.
protocol.decision: Observe all six trajectories without GT arm/iteration selection. Primary joint vs original scalar and same-target scalar per task: >=+.1dB,>=2of3wins,SSIM nondecrease,LPIPS nonincrease. Cross arms report joint-vs-cross differences; evolving-state cross trajectories are POLICY ablations, not A96 fixed-state factorial effects. Record solver budget-hit rates and failures.
protocol.resources: Up to2 allocated GPUs>=8GiB, static case shards, one strict model per worker. Actual root/DPS checkpoint source fingerprint + real primal/adjoint probe required; fixed IEEE. No process termination, precision/resolution change, model download or old source edits. Whole queue detached-safe, live progress, explicit resource-limited/failed status.
